'''Jaygon Rannis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Order of Revan]]. At some point during the [[Galactic War]] he visited both [[Carrick Station]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jaygon Rannis appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion as a vendor on Republic and Imperial fleet, accessible only to those, who pre-ordered the expansion.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
